title: AdLayoutOptimizerOutput
description: Viewability diagnostic and optimization recommendations for a publisher ad layout.

viewability_score_estimate.description: Estimated viewability tier. Low = Better Ads violation or density breach. Medium = no hard violations but room for improvement. High = clean layout with lazy loading and good placement.

layout_violations.description: List of detected violations and warnings. Better Ads hard violations are prefixed with 'Better Ads violation:'. Soft warnings are prefixed with 'Warning:'.

suggested_action.description: Specific technical action to improve viewability or fix violation for this slot.

expected_viewability_uplift.description: Estimated viewability improvement from applying the suggested action.

optimization_recommendations.description: Per-slot optimization recommendations. One entry per slot in current_ad_slots.

layout_violations: Better Ads violation: 320x250 above-the-fold on mobile
Warning: single ad slot — revenue yield suboptimal
Warning: no lazy loading enabled on any slot — impacts Core Web Vitals

optimization_recommendations.suggested_action: Move 320x250 to below-fold or replace with 320x50 leaderboard at top to comply with Better Ads Standards
